title: Rollout Stage Canvas: customer inference milestone & blocker playbook
content:
Purpose: quick, shareable canvas for tracking a customer inference rollout across stages (Discovery → Integration → Validation → Scale → Handover). Focus: milestones, single-point owners, top blockers, immediate next actions, and escalation contacts. Use this as the one-page to attach to weekly CS QBR notes and the technical handoff packet.

How to use (short):
- Update only the Stage rows you own. Keep entries concise (1 line per milestone).
- RAG status should reflect customer-facing risk (Red = jeopardy to go-live, Amber = significant engineering effort, Green = on track).
- Blocker = current top issue preventing next milestone. Next action = the single next step owner will take in 72h.
- Copy the canvas snapshot into the QBR slide deck week-of.

Canvas (living):
1) Discovery (owner: Maya Singh)
   - Milestone: Requirements sign-off (SLOs, data residency, PII controls) — target: 2025-11-15 — RAG: Green
   - Blocker: Pending legal review on telemetry TTL for embeddings (JIRA: JIRA-CUST-9876) — Next action: Asha to confirm minimal telemetry fields and send approved text (ETA 2025-11-10)

2) Integration (owner: Ethan Park)
   - Milestone: Basic API integration & test harness (proxy + SDK) — target: 2025-12-01 — RAG: Amber
   - Blocker: Customer uses proprietary header auth; SDK needs header passthrough hook — Next action: Ethan to propose SDK patch and rollout plan in PR #421 (ETA 2025-11-20)

3) Validation (owner: Diego Alvarez)
   - Milestone: Eval pass on 3 sample prompts + latency SLO verification (p95 <= 300ms) — target: 2026-01-08 — RAG: Amber
   - Blocker: Large variance in p95 due to tokenization edge-case on long prompts — Next action: Diego to attach repro case and coordinate with serving-runtime (SRE) weekly session (ETA 2025-12-01)

4) Scale (owner: Lena Hoffman)
   - Milestone: Dedicated pool sizing and autoscale policy validated — target: 2026-01-22 — RAG: Amber
   - Blocker: Unclear burst budget for test window (finance sign-off) — Next action: Lena to get finance approval and confirm burst quota by 2025-12-10

5) Handover (owner: Customer Success PSG)
   - Milestone: Runbook + escalation card delivered to customer ops — target: 2026-01-30 — RAG: Green
   - Blocker: None open — Next action: Schedule handover run (internal dry-run) 2026-01-25

Assumptions & quick risks: 
- Assumption: Customer will provide a 2-week sample data set for preflight testing within 3 business days of Integration complete. If delayed > 7 days, shift Validation by +1 sprint.
- Risk: Model privacy constraints may require on-prem private deployment; this will add ~6–8 weeks. Flag early in Discovery if legal hints at this.

Escalation ladder (who to ping):
- Level 1 (day-to-day): stage owner (see canvas).
- Level 2 (72h unresolved, Red risk): Customer Success Lead — Asha Mehta (asha@redwood.example).
- Level 3 (sustained production jeopardy or legal/compliance blocking): Head of Solutions — Diego Alvarez (diego@redwood.example) + Product Security.
- Pager (SRE): #sre-inference-alerts (pager duty on-call)

Preflight checklist (short runnable list):
- API: basic token auth succeeds, SDK example runs, sample prompt returns tokens and output.
- Metrics: app-level latency, p95 measured, cost-per-request baseline captured.
- Security: network allowlist tested, KMS key exchange validated, telemetry opt-out verified.
- E2E test: customer-run smoke test passes with 5 synthetic cases.

Blocker playbook (template for common blockers):
- Telemetry/privacy hold: create "telemetry-minimal" payload and get legal sign-off. Map what we need vs what can be redacted.
- Latency regression: pinpoint tokenization cases → mirror sample to staging → run profiling with tracer logs → open SRE ticket with header 'latency-suspect:tokenization' and attach flamegraph.
- Auth mismatch: provide a temporary gateway shim config until SDK patch lands; document TTL for shim, revert plan.
- Capacity mismatch: propose temporary burst pool (cost neutral for customer) for 2-week soak; requires finance approval.

One-pager handoff checklist (to attach at Handover):
- Final model & version pinned, fallback variants documented.
- Rollback procedure (model/version) with <15 min target.
- Contact tree (names + emails + escalation path).
- Runbook links (Confluence id) + test prompt set used for validation.

Notes to self (informal):
- We should add a small matrix mapping customer SLAs → recommended Dedicated config (g4dn vs a100) for upcoming QBR.
- Consider a short 'mini-FAQ' for customers about quantization impact on hallucination vs cost.
- Ask Product to provide a short blurb for the QBR slide that explains caching behavior (prefix caching) in 2 bullets.

Recent changes:
- 2026-02-12: Updated Integration blocker and SDK PR reference.
- 2026-02-28: Clarified Validation SLO (p95 300ms) after engineering sync.

Open questions (to resolve before Validation sign-off):
- Is customer willing to accept aggregated telemetry for anomaly detection (Y/N)? (Action: Asha)
- What is the target concurrency for peak window? (Action: Lena)

Next weekly agenda items (template):
- Quick RAG review (5m)
- Top blocker deep-dive (15m)
- Actions review (10m)
- Decisions needed (5m)

Related artifacts (copy links into linked_artifacts): Confluence runbook draft, JIRA trackers, PRs, and QBR slide deck (attach final snapshot).

-- end canvas --

(Internal: save this snapshot into the customer folder under CS/ for the week-of QBR; this doc is intentionally terse so it can fit into a slide.)
